text.tspan: Share of population living in extreme poverty (after vs. before tax), 1963

Extreme poverty is defined as living below the
International Poverty Line
of $3 per day. This data is adjusted for inflation
and differences in living costs between countries.

Note: This data is expressed in
international-$
at 2021 prices.
